brief.question: Can magnitude-weighted output-Jacobian allocation of sparse residuals improve logit fidelity for the transported first-layer input message at a matched total padded serialized-bit budget in frozen GCN-to-SNN conversion?
brief.answer: On the reported test split, rank-128 transport of M0=A_hat X with a 2% magnitude-weighted output-Jacobian residual budget reduced the ratio of three-seed means of split-specific logit MSE by 26.23%, 33.99%, and 25.83% versus the post-hoc strongest evaluated matched-budget residual control. The maximum three-seed-mean observed task degradation was 1.86 percentage points and the maximum single-seed degradation was 2.85 percentage points.
brief.audience: Graph-compression and neuromorphic-conversion researchers evaluating fidelity/resource trade-offs of frozen ANN/GNN-to-SNN conversion.
brief.domain_bridge: Repeated high-dimensional A X messages dominate transport; retain an operator-aligned rank-128 basis and spend a 2% sparse residual budget on coefficients with high output-Jacobian sensitivity; matched-budget tests show lower logit MSE with bounded task loss.

main: logit-MSE improvement at matched padded bits

terminology.sparse residual coefficients: selected exact message residual values with explicit indices; not temporal spikes
terminology.matched padded bits: identical total_padded_bits within a dataset/seed/rank/budget comparison, allowing different payload lengths
terminology.held-out confirmation: test run after validation-exposed reframing, not preregistered independent replication
terminology.magnitude-weighted output-Jacobian score: s_i=r_i^2 ||J_i||_2^2 for transported input-message residual entries
terminology.input-message transport: compression of M0=A_hat X only, not A_hat H1
terminology.maximum observed degradation: descriptive maximum; not a bound or equivalence result
terminology.strongest evaluated residual control: post-hoc best non-proposed matched-budget residual control by three-seed mean logit MSE per dataset

paragraph_plan.point: Low-rank graph-message transport can preserve the wrong output-sensitive directions under a fixed serialization budget.
Output-Jacobian squared sensitivity selects sparse residual coefficients after SVD transport under an exact padded-bit ledger.
The held-out test run confirms logit-MSE reductions on all three graphs at matched total padded serialized-bit budget.
Hidden-MSE and budget-grid sensitivity show that output-sensitive fidelity improves across evaluated settings.
Task degradation remains bounded, but task superiority is not established; warmed cost is modest in the measured 1% setting.
The evidence supports a local fidelity/resource contribution with explicit static-GCN, conversion, and measurement limits.
Output-Jacobian residual allocation improves logit fidelity within the tested frozen-GCN scope while bounding observed task loss.

section_jobs.Introduction: Open from output-sensitive information loss in compressed graph messages; state the bounded logit-fidelity question and contribution.
section_jobs.Methods: Define only the transported M0 tensor, valid rank, global transductive selection, composite magnitude-weighted Jacobian score, exact 64-bit pair ledger, rate coding, split/seed semantics, controls, comparators, and validation-test chronology.
section_jobs.Experiments and Results: Report matched-budget logit MSE, bounded task loss, prior-art adaptations and warmed cost without table-cell narration.
section_jobs.Discussion: Interpret fidelity gains and task trade-offs; distinguish observed results from mechanism hypotheses; state limits.
section_jobs.Conclusion: Answer the question with the three-graph result and no new promise.

facts.uncertainty: negative evidence retained; no equivalence claim

facts.statement: The transported tensor is the first-layer input message M0=A_hat X of shape N x F; rank 128 is valid because F exceeds 128 on all three datasets. The second aggregation A_hat H1 and output layer are not compressed by this method.

The evaluated selector ranks residual entries by the composite score s_i=r_i^2 ||J_i||_2^2, where J_i is the analytic derivative of frozen ANN logits with respect to a transported message entry under the ReLU hidden mask. Selection is global per dataset and checkpoint seed over the full transductive graph message and does not use labels.

The 2% budget selects round(0.02*N*F) residual entries; each selected index-value pair is charged 64 bits, and the rank-128 basis is charged (N*128+128+128*F)*32 bits. Total padded cost is basis bits plus residual padded bits. Cora, Chameleon, and Squirrel totals are 21,932,736, 25,630,208, and 43,771,008 bits.

Matched-budget controls include top-absolute residual selection, random indices, dense uniform residual quantization, an A2Q-style node-budget adaptation, and a One-Spike-style coefficient adaptation. The proposed composite selector beats top-absolute selection in all nine dataset-seed logit-MSE comparisons; the full-float and SVD-only rows are references, not matched residual-budget controls.
facts.model: frozen two-layer hidden-16 GCN checkpoints seeds 0/1/2
facts.condition: rank 128, 2% residual-entry budget, matched total padded serialized bits
facts.metric: logit MSE and paired dataset-seed direction
facts.uncertainty: descriptive paired evidence; no formal CI claimed

facts.statement: Using the best matched-budget non-proposed control separately for each dataset and task metric, the maximum three-seed-mean observed degradation was 0.53, 1.17, and 1.86 percentage points on Cora, Chameleon, and Squirrel; the maximum single-seed degradation across all metrics was 2.85 percentage points. These are observed maxima, not bounds or equivalence results.
facts.model: frozen two-layer hidden-16 GCN checkpoints seeds 0/1/2
facts.condition: T=2/4 accuracy and teacher agreement versus per-metric matched-budget control
facts.aggregation: maximum of three-seed-mean metric degradations; maximum single-seed degradation

facts.statement: Timing at rank128/1% includes basis construction, residual construction and selection, reconstruction, rate conversion, and evaluation with the frozen model, adjacency, and features precomputed. Each method/dataset/seed p95 is the 0.95 quantile of seven measured elapsed times after three warmups, with CUDA synchronization before and after each call.

Validation exposed ranks 16, 32, 64, and 128 and residual budgets 0.5%, 1%, and 2%. Guidance-v3 fixed rank128 and 2% after validation exposure and before the confirmation test run. The test is held-out confirmation after validation exposure, not preregistered or independent replication.

internal.note: P10 repairs are evidence-backed. Independent replication, formal task equivalence, energy/downstream utility, interaction ablations, and focal 2% timing remain outside the accepted claim and must not be invented.
